title: The Fish Shop
lines: Kim has a fish shop. She sells fish.
A cat picks up a big fish and runs.
Kim shuts the shop and runs to the cat.
The cat runs to a shed. Six wet cats!
"You can have the fish," said Kim.
Kim gets a big dish and fills it up.
The six cats run to the dish.
Kim is not mad. She has lots of fish.

questions.ask: What does the cat take from the shop?
questions.listenFor: A big fish. Line two says it - send them back to that line if they are not sure.

questions.ask: What does Kim find at the shed?
questions.listenFor: Six wet cats. If they say only "cats," ask them to find the word that tells how many.

questions.ask: Kim was yelling at the start and not mad at the end. What do you think changed her mind? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Their own thinking. Seeing the six wet cats is the moment it turns, but the story never says so out loud - that is theirs to put together.
